sources.title: Nvidia's Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4: 27B Parameter AI Now Runs on Consumer ...
sources.snippet: Nvidia's NVFP4 quantization of Alibaba's Qwen3.6-27B cuts memory by 2.5x with under 1% accuracy loss. The 19.7GB model runs on RTX PRO 6000 and DGX Spark, delivering up to 2,000+ tokens/sec with vLLM and MTP speculative decoding.

sources.title: Qwen 3.6 27B Benchmark Deep Dive: The Measured Numbers
sources.snippet: Key Takeaways Qwen 3.6 27B is a 27B dense model with a hybrid linear-attention plus sparse-MoE architecture and a 256K-token context window, per third-party model card copy. NVFP4 quantization delivers roughly 2.6-2.86× decode speedup over BF16 in one VLLM benchmark, at MMLU 0.8446 accuracy.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B at 4-bit: Why NVFP4 Quantization Came Down to Hopper
sources.snippet: NVIDIA's Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 compresses a 27B hybrid-attention reasoning model to 4-bit, cutting memory by roughly 2.5x while keeping benchmark gaps within 1 point of FP8. Unlike the earlier Gemma NVFP4 build that effectively required Blackwell, this one lists Hopper as a supported target, so any team already running H100/H200 can try it on-premises today.
